dated.title: The Hour of Grace – Eucharistic Adoration and Benediction

good_to_know: For Last Rites or urgent care of the seriously ill after hours, call 6344 0046 to reach the priest on duty.
Columbarium open daily 6am–10pm; lift daily 9am–7pm, and 8.30am–12 noon on public holidays.
Katong Catholic Shop: Tue–Fri 12 noon–6.30pm, Sat–Sun 8.30am–5.30pm; closed Mondays and public holidays.

events.title: The Chosen Encounter & Premiere of Season 6
events.text: 9.30am–11.30am at Holy Family Church Pastoral Centre Level 3, St Ephrem Room. Scripture, reflection and faith sharing, followed by a screening of The Chosen Season 6, Episode 1. Register through the QR code.

events.title: Video programme 'Eternal Rest – The Art of Dying Well' (Part 2)
events.text: 7.45pm–9.30pm at Pastoral Centre Level 1 Multi-Purpose Hall. Explores the Church's teaching on death, dying and everlasting life. All warmly welcome.

events.title: Pieta Singapore – support group for bereaved parents
events.text: Monthly session on Zoom, 7.30pm–9.15pm, for parents who have lost a child: prayer, reflection and breaking open the Word of God. Email pieta.singapore@gmail.com for the Zoom link.

events.title: Advent Reflection 2026
events.text: Tuesdays 24 Nov and 1, 8 and 15 Dec, 7.45pm–9.30pm at Holy Family Church Pastoral Centre Level 3 (St Ephrem room). Scripture reflection on the Advent readings followed by sharing; come with family and friends. Register by 22 Nov via the QR code.

events.title: Opening the Word of Life – reading and reflecting on Sunday's Eucharistic readings
events.text: Wednesdays 25 Nov and 2, 9 and 16 Dec, 8pm–9.30pm at Pastoral Centre Level 1 Multi-Purpose Hall. Read, reflect and share on the coming Sunday's readings to prepare for Mass.

events.title: Video programme 'Adventus – A Spiritual Pilgrimage' (morning session)
events.text: 9.30am–10.45am at Church Level 4 Function Hall Dome. FORMED documentary journeying to the Holy Land, with discussion and prayer. All warmly welcome.

events.title: Video programme 'Adventus – A Spiritual Pilgrimage' (evening session)
events.text: 8pm–9.30pm at Pastoral Centre Level 1 Multi-Purpose Hall. FORMED documentary journeying to the Holy Land, with discussion and prayer. All warmly welcome.

events.title: Cancer Support Group
events.text: 7.30pm at the Holy Family Adoration Room, every 1st Monday of the month. For cancer patients, survivors, caregivers, families and friends. WhatsApp Helen at 98389767 for details.

events.title: Youth Christmas Party 2026
events.text: 7pm–10pm at Holy Family Church, Pastoral Centre Level 1, for youths aged 16–26. Dinner provided; wear red or green. Registration closes 6 December via the Google Form.
